name: Tianfu Palace
description: Draw inspiration from the heavenly palace of Si Mingxingjun in Chu mythology. The Cangsheng tree records the destiny of all things in the world, and each leaf has a destiny. The Tianfu Palace was built in compliance with the giant tree. The leaves of the Cangsheng tree are used as green tiles of the palace. They are built in the sky, which means that the destiny of all life has a trace to follow, and together they build the world.
